I have built and configured the complete **KHERLEED DATA** platform following your architectural flow.

---

### 🏛️ System Architecture Implementation

```text
                       KHERLEED DATA
                             │
                  ┌──────────┴──────────┐
                  │                     │
               CUSTOMER               AGENT
                  │                     │
                  └──────────┬──────────┘
                             │
                        WALLET SYSTEM
                             │
                  ┌──────────┴──────────┐
                  │                     │
           VIRTUAL ACCOUNT          ONLINE PAYMENT
                  │                     │
                  └──────────┬──────────┘
                             │
                        WALLET BALANCE
                             │
            ┌────────────────┼────────────────┐
            │                │                │
           DATA            AIRTIME         BILLS
            │                │                │
           MTN             MTN              DSTV (Staged for Future)
          Airtel           Airtel            GOTV (Staged for Future)
           Glo              Glo            Electricity (Staged for Future)
         9mobile          9mobile
```

---

### 🌟 What Has Been Built

1. **User Roles (Customer & Agent)**:
   - **Customer Mode**: Retail rates for personal top-ups.
   - **Agent Mode**: Wholesale reseller pricing (e.g. MTN 1GB SME at ₦260 vs ₦280 retail) and higher airtime discounts (up to 4.0%).
   - **Role Switcher**: Accessible in the header bar with one click to easily test and demonstrate both Customer and Agent rates.
   - [**`AgentHub`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/AgentHub.tsx): Includes an interactive Reseller Profit Calculator and a side-by-side Customer vs Agent price comparison table.

2. **Dual-Engine Wallet System**:
   - [**`WalletCard`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/WalletCard.tsx): Displays available balance with hide/reveal toggle, quick action buttons, and a dedicated bank transfer preview strip.
   - [**`VirtualAccountModal`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/VirtualAccountModal.tsx): Generates dedicated virtual account numbers (**Wema Bank**, **Moniepoint MFB**, **PalmPay / Squad**) for bank transfers. Features a **Live Test Simulator** so you can simulate instant deposits.
   - [**`OnlinePaymentModal`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/OnlinePaymentModal.tsx): Instant gateway supporting Card, USSD, and QR payments with preset amounts.

3. **Active Services**:
   - [**`BuyDataForm`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/BuyDataForm.tsx):
     - Networks: **MTN**, **Airtel**, **Glo**, and **9mobile**.
     - Data categories: **SME Data**, **Corporate Gifting (CG)**, and **Direct Gifting**.
     - Real-time Nigerian network prefix detection (e.g. `0803` / `0814` auto-selects MTN; `0802` auto-selects Airtel; `0805` auto-selects Glo; `0809` auto-selects 9mobile).
     - PIN authorization and balance check before deduction.
   - [**`BuyAirtimeForm`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/BuyAirtimeForm.tsx):
     - Instant airtime VTU for MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile with automatic percentage discount (Customer: 2.0% - 2.5%, Agent: 3.5% - 4.0%).
   - [**`BillsPreview`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/BillsPreview.tsx):
     - As requested (*"But for now I’ll not include bills maybe in the future"*), **DSTV**, **GOTV**, and **Electricity** are cleanly staged as **"Coming Soon / Future Phase"** with notification triggers, keeping the system focused on Data & Airtime.

4. **Statements & Receipts**:
   - [**`TransactionHistory`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/TransactionHistory.tsx): Full filterable audit ledger with search by reference, phone number, or service.
   - [**`ReceiptModal`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/ReceiptModal.tsx): Official branded receipt popup with print (`window.print`) and share capabilities.
   - [**`ArchitectureFlow`**](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/components/ArchitectureFlow.tsx): A live interactive diagram mapping your exact structure right at the top of the app.

---

### 📂 Key Files Created & Configured
- App State Context: [`src/context/AppContext.tsx`](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/context/AppContext.tsx)
- Telecom Plans & Networks: [`src/data/plans.ts`](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/data/plans.ts)
- Type Definitions: [`src/types/index.ts`](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/types/index.ts)
- Utilities & Network Detectors: [`src/lib/utils.ts`](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/src/lib/utils.ts)
- Documentation: [`README.md`](https://github.com/kherleed32/i-want-to-create-my-own/blob/main/README.md)
